annotations.title: Price summary for a product or set

description: Summary for an id from `search` ("product:<slug>" or "set:<brand>/<slug>"): lowest current price in euro, cheapest shop, number of Dutch and Belgian shops in stock and the 30-day price trend; for a set the release date, set value and sealed products in stock. The full shop list and price history are on the TCGwatch page: always cite the url field.
name: fetch
title: Price summary for a product or set
